scenarios.name: Baseline Weekday Midday
scenarios.description: Z-class movement up the Ashram Road spine on a quiet Tuesday early afternoon — the reference case: default event rates, no weather, standard 120 s rolling closure.

scenarios.name: Monsoon Evening Peak
scenarios.description: MANDATED ANCHOR — monsoon evening. Z+ airport arrival into the city at 18:30 in active monsoon (18 mm/h rain): Airport Road into Shahibaug, Dr. Ambedkar Road and Relief Road to the Kalupur station approach (1014) — its scheduled waterlogging plus evening-peak demand and weather-damped free-flow make this the worst single-weather case.

forced_events.label: Kalupur station approach waterlogged — 45 min pump-out

scenarios.name: Multi-Event Collision at Kalupur
scenarios.description: MANDATED ANCHOR — multi-event collision. A Z movement through the Kalupur junction complex (J8/J15) at 17:50 Friday while a double-lane breakdown blocks Station Road, a signal fault collapses the J8 greens, and a monsoon shower waterlogs the Relief Road approach to Kalupur — three simultaneous capacity hits on one junction complex, all on the convoy's path.

forced_events.label: truck breakdown blocking 2 lanes at Kalupur approach
J8 signal controller fault — flashing amber
waterlogged Relief Road approach to Kalupur

scenarios.name: Z+ Airport Run at Morning Peak
scenarios.description: MANDATED ANCHOR — Z+ at peak. Head-of-state class run city → airport at 08:45 Monday: maximum protocol closure (180 s advance), full closure type, morning-peak demand on the Relief Road - Dr. Ambedkar Road - Airport Road corridor, plus the Monday commute peak in full swing.

scenarios.name: Sunday Market Spillover (Old City)
scenarios.description: Y-class run through the Lal Darwaja bazaar cluster at 11:00 Sunday: market spillover demand saturates Relief/Gandhi/Swami Vivekananda Roads while Sunday shoppers queue at the J3/J5 signals.

scenarios.name: Political Rally Spillover, Saturday Evening
scenarios.description: A scheduled rally on the Ashram Road riverfront at 17:00 Saturday pours 900 veh/h of extra arrivals onto the corridor while a Z-class movement runs the spine in the opposite shoulder of the evening peak.

forced_events.label: riverfront rally — 15k attendees, parking spillover
rally dispersal onto Ashram Road southbound

scenarios.name: Signal Faults at Friday Peak
scenarios.description: Signal-controller faults at J1 and J8 during the Friday 18:00 peak while an X-class medical convoy crosses the city — tests green-ratio collapse under saturated demand without any physical blockage.

forced_events.label: J1 controller fault — flashing red
J8 detector fault — stuck green one side

scenarios.name: Night Owl — Low Demand
scenarios.description: X-class run at 02:30 Wednesday night: near-empty roads, minimal disruption, quick recovery — the floor case that calibrates how much of peak-hour delay is demand-driven rather than closure-driven.

scenarios.name: Monsoon Morning Commute (SG Highway)
scenarios.description: Y-class run west on SG Highway at 09:00 in moderate monsoon rain (8 mm/h) — morning-peak demand on the motorway with weather-damped free-flow and elevated breakdown rates.

scenarios.name: Multi-Lane Breakdown on SP Ring Road
scenarios.description: Z-class run on the eastern ring road when a container truck loses two of eight lanes for 35 minutes mid-route — tests partial-capacity closures interacting with a rolling convoy window.

forced_events.label: container truck jackknifed — 2 lanes blocked

scenarios.name: Match Night at Motera
scenarios.description: T20 match dispersal at Motera stadium: scheduled spillover of 1100 veh/h onto the stadium road and its neighbours at 20:15 while a Z-class movement brings the dignitary out through the same corridor.

forced_events.label: post-match dispersal surge

scenarios.name: Winter Fog Morning
scenarios.description: X-class run at 07:30 in late-December fog: visibility caps urban free-flow at ~55% and shifts the morning peak later; tests weather speed caps without rain or events.

scenarios.name: Friday Market Evening (CG Road)
scenarios.description: Friday 19:00 run along CG Road: late-shopping market spillover on the adjacent Relief Road cluster combines with the extended Friday evening peak; the signal_hold policy variant shows the lighter-touch closure option under sustained demand.

forced_events.label: Friday bazaar spillover from Relief Road

scenarios.name: Republic Day Parade Morning
scenarios.description: Jan 26 morning: a scheduled parade on the Gandhinagar Highway strip (staged, 09:00–10:30) plus holiday-morning demand shape; a Z-class movement runs the airport corridor through the tail of the parade window.

forced_events.label: Republic Day parade — spectators and parking

scenarios.name: VVIP Convoy — Base Case (Z+ state-capital run)
scenarios.description: BASE CASE. Z+ protected movement from Gandhinagar into the city core on a Monday mid-morning: down the Gandhinagar-Ahmedabad Highway (1026-1025-1024) through Koba and Bhat Circles, over the Indira Bridge (1048), along Airport Road (1028-1027) to Shahibaug and in on Dr. Ambedkar Road (1043) to Lal Darwaja. Maximum-protocol closure (180 s advance, full closure), default event rates, no weather — the reference movement every other use case is a generalization of.

scenarios.name: Jagannath Rath Yatra — Old-City Procession
scenarios.description: 148th Ahmedabad Rath Yatra (27 Jun 2025): three chariots step off at 07:00 from the ~400-year-old Jamalpur temple and crawl the old-city bazaar belt of India's second-largest Rath Yatra (~14 km in all). Modeled on the walled city's real streets: east along one-way Gandhi Road to Kalupur (1012), south past Sarangpur Darwaja (1049) and west along one-way Swami Vivekananda Road toward Jamalpur (1013), with Relief Road (1005) shut alongside. Modeled as an X-class managed movement (the procession itself, not a protected person) at chariot pace (8 km/h, the engine floor) with full street closure rolling ahead of it and lakhs-strong crowd load on every segment.

forced_events.label: three chariots + lakhs of devotees on Gandhi Road — yatra out-leg
chariot crawl on Relief Road — old-city bazaar belt closed
Swami Vivekananda Road bazaar crowd pinned behind barricades

scenarios.name: Rath Yatra Morning, Monsoon Burst, One Siren
scenarios.description: FLAGSHIP multi-event showcase. 09:20 on the real 148th Rath Yatra morning of 27 Jun 2025 (procession stepped off 07:00 from Jamalpur): three chariots crawl Gandhi Road and Relief Road with lakhs on the street, a monsoon burst at 18 mm/h waterlogs the Nehru Bridge approach, bazaar crowds stand behind Swami Vivekananda Road barricades — and a 108 ambulance carrying a cardiac patient requests a green corridor across the river: Relief Road -> Nehru Bridge -> Ashram Road south -> Riverfront West (1005->1015->1001->1006). The engine's answer: closure_policy = signal_hold at 45 s advance, threading a medical convoy between a public festival and the weather.

forced_events.label: three chariots + lakhs on Gandhi Road — yatra in its third hour
chariot crawl turns onto Relief Road — bazaar belt regulated, not stopped
monsoon burst at 18 mm/h waterlogs the Nehru Bridge approach (scheduled waterlogging)
Swami Vivekananda Road bazaar crowd behind barricades
108 cardiac green-corridor window — Relief Road stretch
108 cardiac green-corridor window — Nehru Bridge crossing
108 cardiac green-corridor window — Riverfront West
108 cardiac green-corridor window — Ashram South handover

scenarios.name: Kumbh-Class Mass Gathering — Perimeter Zone
scenarios.description: A Kumbh-class bathing-day window (the Maha Kumbh 2025 class: ~660 million visits over the mela, largest gathering on earth). The corridor problem inverts: the zone interior is car-free and frozen; what the engine manages is the perimeter ring and the ingress surges. Modeled on the corridor network's riverfront cluster — Ashram Road south (1001) onto Riverfront West (1006) and up Ashram Road through Usmanpura (1009) — with an X-class supply/medical shuttle entering the zone at 04:30 pre-dawn under signal_hold (signals keep cycling: staged ingress, not blanket freeze).

forced_events.label: riverfront zone core — bathing-day ingress surge (Kumbh-class footfall)
east-bank queueing corridors at capacity
Ashram Road approach saturated by pilgrim arrivals

scenarios.name: City Marathon — Sabarmati Riverfront Race Corridor
scenarios.description: Adani Ahmedabad Marathon class (9th edition: 24,000+ runners on the Sabarmati Riverfront, 24 Nov 2024; World Athletics calendar). A 05:45 gun start means the race corridor (Riverfront East 1007 - Nehru Bridge 1015 - Ashram South 1001 - Riverfront West 1006) is closed to vehicles in the dark and reopens in stages behind the sweep. Modeled as an X-class pace/sweep convoy at 12 km/h under full closure with spectator spillover forced on the two approach segments.

forced_events.label: 24,000+ runners + spectator vehicles pressing the riverfront road
spectator spillover onto Ashram Road south

scenarios.name: Republic Day / Independence Day — Ceremonial Parade Corridor
scenarios.description: The two fixed ceremonial days every year. At the 76th Republic Day (26 Jan 2025) the Governor hoisted the flag and took the parade salute with the CM present (Gujarat CMO) — a Z-class protected movement to the venue up the GN Highway strip. Modeled: dignitary runs from SVPI airport (1029-1028) over the Indira Bridge (1048) onto the GN Highway parade strip at Bhat (1024-1025) at 08:35, arriving before the 09:00 flag, while spectator and parking load saturates the strip itself. Independence Day (15 Aug) is the calendar mirror.

forced_events.label: Republic Day parade — grandstand spectators and parking on the GN Highway strip
spectator approach traffic on GN Highway south

scenarios.name: Stadium Egress — Narendra Modi Stadium Match Night
scenarios.description: Narendra Modi Stadium (Motera): ~132,000 seats, the world's largest cricket ground; ~130,000 in the house for the IPL 2026 final and ~3,000 police + ~1,000 home guards with published traffic advisories and diversions for the T20 World Cup 2026 final. The corridor event is the 90-120 min egress surge — modeled at 20:05, just after a final ball: an X-class ambulance with a green-corridor request fights the dispersal wave from Motera Stadium Road (1032) over the Chimanbhai Patel Flyover (1041) down the Ashram spine (1009-1002-1001) under signal_hold, with the surge and one stalled car forced on the egress segments.

forced_events.label: ~130k spectators dispersing from Narendra Modi Stadium
egress wave onto Ashram Road north
stalled car blocking one dispersal lane
green-corridor ambulance crossing the dispersal wave

scenarios.name: Monsoon Flood — Evacuation and Relief Corridor
scenarios.description: Gujarat floods, 27 Aug 2024 class: ~280 mm of rain in 24 h, 28+ dead, 24,000+ relocated statewide, NDRF and Army columns running boat rescues as low-lying city cores went under. Modeled on the corridor network: the low-lying river spine (1001/1006/1015) waterlogs while an X-class relief column runs the reverse-flow evacuation spine — Sarkhej (1040) onto SP Ring Road (1021-1022-1008), the high-ground detour — at 11:20 in 22 mm/h rain under signal_hold, with evacuee traffic surging onto the ring road behind it.

forced_events.label: Ashram Road south under water — low-lying spine flooded
riverfront west carriageway submerged
Nehru Bridge approach pumping
evacuee traffic surging onto SP Ring Road
abandoned vehicle on the flooded ring-road shoulder

scenarios.name: Planned Infrastructure Work Zone — Metro/Bullet-Train Works
scenarios.description: The most predictable corridor event: months-long lane loss published in advance. Ahmedabad Metro Phase 2 (Motera to Gandhinagar's Mahatma Mandir, built since Feb 2021; 77.63 km network approved) put Kankaria Road under a published 3 Jul - 30 Sep closure with diversions, and ~100 m at Kalupur Bridge shut for bullet-train pillar work. Modeled: an X-class inspection convoy at 09:15 runs Kasturba Gandhi Road (1031) through the Kalupur pinch (1014), south past Sarangpur Darwaja (1049) and onto Kankaria Road (1038) while both work zones hold two barricaded lanes (long-duration forced lane-loss) and diverted bazaar traffic squeezes Kankaria Road itself.

forced_events.label: Kankaria Road metro works — two lanes barricaded (published 3 Jul-30 Sep closure)
Kalupur Bridge bullet-train pillar works — standing lane loss on Station Road
diverted bazaar traffic squeezing Kankaria Road
